walkthroughs.title: Sign up to first AI plans
walkthroughs.description: A new user signs up, signs in, sets profile, goal, diet and allergies, then gets an AI weekly workout plan and an AI meal plan (G1).

walkthroughs.title: A day of logging
walkthroughs.description: From today's checklist the user ticks breakfast, logs a meal, checks calories, logs a workout, water and weight (G2, G3).
